title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
tldr: The paper presents 'System 1 agents,' a local agentic AI method that avoids LLM text generation by compiling tool schemas and user requests into multiple-choice questions answered by a one-pass decision model, reducing hallucinations and improving tool-call reliability for biomedical/clinical applications.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种“System 1 agents”方法，通过确定性编译器将工具架构和用户请求转化为选择题，并由单次前向决策模型作答，从而避免大语言模型生成自由文本，降低幻觉，提高本地医疗/临床智能体的工具调用可靠性。
summary_zh: 代理式人工智能可自动化分析敏感临床数据，但当前的代理依赖大型语言模型（LLM）。云端LLM会暴露患者数据。本地LLM会产生幻觉，且工具调用中出现的虚构值会传播至后续每一步。本文提出一种构建系统1代理的方法：即不生成文本而直接调用工具的本地代理。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式和请求转换为多项选择题，选项来自请求和模式，随后由单遍决策模型作答。在针对157个生物医学工具的1,952个请求中，最优系统1代理为97.0%的请求选择了正确的工具或恰当地拒绝作答，显著优于全部18种本地LLM代理设置（最佳为95.2%）。系统1代理填入了6,056个已声明参数值中的97.0%。系统1调用中未含任何虚构内容，而LLM调用中虚构内容占比为5.5%–19.7%。SystemOneAgents框架作为开源软件免费提供，访问地址：https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents。

title: Non-Imaging Optical Tactile Sensors for Robotics: Transduction Principles, System Integration, and Robotic Applications
summary: Non-imaging optical tactile sensors encode contact through changes in optical intensity, wavelength, spectra, or photon counts, offering diverse architectures for robotic touch. Their usefulness depends on whether contact variables can be reliably distinguished from coupled mechanical and environmental effects, and whether the resulting information can be delivered in time to guide action. This review develops a unified framework linking mechanical load transmission, optical encoding, readout, and tactile inference to robotic task requirements. It examines reflective and waveguide-based devices, micro/nanofibers, fiber gratings, interferometric and resonant structures, and mechanoluminescent composites. Three considerations emerge across these approaches. First, high optical sensitivity supports accurate tactile estimation only when target variables remain identifiable under the relevant contact and calibration conditions. Second, spatial coverage and feedback timing must be assessed at the system level, accounting for multiplexing, acquisition, demodulation, and inference. Third, device characterization, offline recognition, and closed-loop robotic performance provide distinct levels of evidence and require different evaluation criteria. Representative studies illustrate how these considerations shape force estimation, contact localization, slip correction and distributed interaction. This review concludes with priorities for calibration transfer, reliable interfaces, scalable readout, and task-based validation, providing a basis for selecting and developing non-imaging optical tactile architectures for robotics.
tldr: A review of non-imaging optical tactile sensors, proposing a unified framework across transduction, readout, inference, and robotic tasks; identifies key design considerations and validation levels.
tldr_zh: 综述非成像光学触觉传感器，提出涵盖光编码、读取、推理与机器人任务需求的统一框架，并总结校准、接口、可扩展读取和任务验证等优先方向。
summary_zh: 非成像光学触觉传感器通过光学强度、波长、光谱或光子计数的变化来编码接触信息，为机器人触觉提供了多种架构方案。其有用性取决于接触变量能否与耦合的机械和环境效应可靠区分，以及由此产生的信息能否及时传递以指导动作。本综述建立了一个统一框架，将机械载荷传递、光学编码、读出和触觉推断与机器人任务需求联系起来。它考察了反射式和波导型器件、微纳光纤、光纤光栅、干涉和谐振结构以及力致发光复合材料。在这些方法中涌现出三个关键考量。第一，仅在目标变量在相关接触和标定条件下保持可识别时，高光学灵敏度才能支持准确的触觉估计。第二，空间覆盖和反馈时序必须在系统层面进行评估，需考虑复用、采集、解调与推断。第三，器件表征、离线识别和闭环机器人性能提供了不同层级的证据，需要采用不同的评价标准。代表性研究展示了这些考量如何影响力估计、接触定位、滑动校正和分布式交互。本综述最后提出了标定迁移、可靠接口、可扩展读出和基于任务的验证等优先事项，为选择和开发用于机器人技术的非成像光学触觉架构提供了基础。

title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
summary: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.
tldr: The paper proposes Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS), a method for fine-tuning medical LLMs on instruction data that improves medical capability while preserving patient-facing safety, achieving higher safety rates than baselines across Llama and Qwen models.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出可扩展的双层数据选择方法（S-BDS），在医学大语言模型指令微调中提升医学能力的同时保持面向患者的安全性，并在Llama和Qwen模型上取得了优于基线的安全率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
随着通用大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被应用于面向患者的医疗场景，在提升医疗能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍是一项关键挑战。大规模医疗指令数据对于通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识至关重要，但不安全的响应可能削弱已有的安全对齐。针对这一问题，我们提出了可扩展的双层数据选择方法（S-BDS），用于安全保留的医疗监督微调。通过控制选择权重的集中程度，S-BDS能够在大型候选池中实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出既能提升医疗能力又能控制面向患者风险的训练示例。我们将经临床医生验证的安全数据与筛选出的数据，以及未经筛选的医疗指令数据结合起来进行监督微调，并分别在HealthBench和PatientSafetyBench上联合评估医疗能力与面向患者的安全性。在Llama和Qwen模型上的实验表明，S-BDS在所有对比方法中取得了最高的安全率，分别比最强基线高出4.64和3.00个百分点，同时保持了具有竞争力的医疗能力。进一步实验表明，在监督微调过程中调整安全导向的权重，可以控制医疗能力与面向患者安全性之间的权衡。

title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.
tldr: The paper proposes evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework that uses clinician-verified LLM adjudications to calibrate confidence, prioritize uncertain line-of-therapy cases for manual review, and iteratively improve automated oncology treatment-history adjudication while reducing clinician workload.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种“证据校准选择”（ECS）的人机协同框架，利用临床医生验证后的LLM判定结果来校准置信度，优先将最不确定的治疗线数判定案例交给人工审查，并随着证据积累持续减少人工负担，用于肿瘤治疗史判定。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）使得扩展临床判定任务成为可能，这些任务传统上依赖详尽的人工审查。治疗线数（LoT）判定是肿瘤队列构建中的主要瓶颈，就是一个典型例子。必须根据细致且特定于研究的定义，从纵向治疗史中推断每位患者在每次方案转换时的治疗线边界。LLMs可以大规模应用这种判定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史的复杂性各不相同，模糊或非典型的模式依赖于专家临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要模型分配得到经验验证的支持，并具备识别需要人工审查病例的能力。在此，我们提出了证据校准选择（ECS），一种用于扩展LLM辅助LoT判定的人机协同框架。ECS从已观察到的临床医生判定中推导置信度，优先将支持最少的患者分配用于后续审查，并将完成的判定作为先例返回给模型。随着证据基础的扩大，ECS持续校准置信度以估计残差，从而更有效地利用临床医生时间。在对136名经临床医生判定的多发性骨髓瘤患者进行的模拟中，ECS在审查44.6%的患者后实现了5%的残差，而由LLM自我报告置信度引导审查时的残差为62.2%，随机抽样时为81.9%。这些结果支持一种可扩展的研究特定LoT判定方法，利用临床医生证据来指导自动预测、最小化误差并减轻审查负担。

title: Inverse Kinematics in Endoscopic Scenarios using MoveIt
summary: Inverse kinematics are critical in many robotic applications, yet standard MoveIt-based solvers struggle in confined scenarios. This paper provides a benchmark of the available solvers and compares multiple practical modifications for improving the performance of the solvers. Splitting the IK problem into two parts results in the best performance, leading to a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.
tldr: The paper benchmarks MoveIt-based inverse kinematics solvers for confined endoscopic scenarios and shows that splitting the IK problem into two parts achieves 100% success under 100 ms in a tank testbed.
tldr_zh: 该论文在内镜受限场景下对基于MoveIt的逆运动学求解器进行了基准测试，并表明将IK问题拆分为两部分可在水箱测试中实现100%成功率且耗时低于100毫秒。
summary_zh: 逆运动学在许多机器人应用中至关重要，然而基于MoveIt的标准求解器在受限场景中表现不佳。本文对现有求解器进行了基准测试，并比较了多种提高求解器性能的实际改进方法。将逆运动学问题分解为两个部分获得了最佳性能，在内窥镜水箱场景中实现了100毫秒内100%的成功率。
